title: The Village at Skyline Pines
description: thevillagerc.com 251 GB 108K files The Village at Skyline Pines is a senior living community in Rapid City, South Dakota, offering assisted living and specialized memory care. Family owned and operated by Cory and Kelli Back since March 2021, it houses 101 units and 116 beds in a three story 106,619 square foot building set into the Black Hills overlooking the city. The complex includes 63 assisted living units and two secure memory care wings with 38 rooms for Alzheimer's and dementia residents. Around 103 residents are served by over 80 staff, with chef prepared meals, chapel, movie theater, salon, courtyard and transportation included. Administrator Kelli Back was named 2022 Assisted Living Administrator of the Year by the South Dakota Healthcare Association. The community holds a 5.0 Google rating from 37 reviews and a state license number 67721, with pricing ranging from about 2500 to 5500 dollars per month.
